title: Reel Seattle Theater Registry
description: Canonical list of theaters supported by Reel Seattle. Authored in data/theaters.json and deployed as public/data/theaters.json. v1.1 adds optional D06 visit metadata (nullable); pricing and hours remain deferred.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this document shape (e.g. 1.1.0).

updated_at.description: Date the registry was last edited (ISO 8601 date).

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Never rename once showtimes reference it.

name.description: Canonical display name shown in the app and written to showtime records.

aliases.description: Alternate names from scrapers or historical data. Matched case-insensitively after trim.

source.description: Adapter that ingests this theater (amc, siff, beacon, etc.).

source_external_id.description: Vendor-specific ID (e.g. AMC API theatre id). Used for API calls; null until populated.

enabled.description: When false, scrapers and the processor should skip this theater.

type.description: Venue category for UX and filtering.

city.description: Primary city for display and future map features.

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood or district within the city.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for showtime date interpretation.

address_line1.description: Street address line 1 (curated; D06). Null until curated.

address_line2.description: Street address line 2 (suite, floor). Null until curated.

state.description: State or province code (e.g. WA). Null until curated.

postal_code.description: Postal / ZIP code. Null until curated.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude. Curated; scrapers must not silently overwrite (D06).

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude. Curated; scrapers must not silently overwrite (D06).

website_url.description: Absolute https theater website URL. Null until curated.

directions_url.description: Absolute maps/directions URL. Optional; clients may derive from address/coords.

phone.description: Public contact phone. Null until curated.

short_description.description: Curated short venue description. Never scraper-invented.

screen_count.description: Number of screens. Null until curated.

capabilities.description: Stable projection/format capabilities (e.g. 35mm, IMAX). Curated durable hardware — not weekly showtimes.

amenities.description: Stable amenity labels (e.g. Concessions, Accessible). Pricing/hours deferred.

image_url.description: Shared hero/thumb image URL or site-relative /theater-images/ path. Rights-cleared only. Null until curated. Prefer image_hero_url / image_thumbnail_url when sizes differ.

image_hero_url.description: Optional detail-hero image (absolute http(s) or /theater-images/…). Falls back to image_url.

image_thumbnail_url.description: Optional list-card thumbnail (absolute http(s) or /theater-images/…). Falls back to image_url then hero.

image_attribution.description: Required attribution text when any image_* URL is set.

image_license.description: Optional short license label (e.g. CC BY 4.0, venue permission 2026).
